summary: merge-grid-stats postinstall performs cloud metadata reconnaissance and writes marker files outside the package directory
details: The package advertises itself as a 'Lightweight utility for merge-style grid games' but its postinstall script (install-cb.js, invoked via scripts.postinstall='node install-cb.js') probes cloud instance-metadata endpoints — AWS 169.254.169.254, Aliyun 100.100.100.200, Tencent metadata.tencentyun.com, and 169.254.0.23 — using curl and http.request at install time. The script writes NCODE_META.txt and NCODE_POC_MARKER.txt into the current working directory as well as `..` and `../..`, dropping files two directories above the install location. index.js contains only trivial score-math stubs unrelated to the postinstall behavior, so the advertised game-utility purpose is a decoy for install-time reconnaissance and directory-traversal file drops. A self-label of 'Authorized PoC (non-destructive)' in the script comment does not change the observed behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
